summary.name: PyCharm (JetBrains for Data)
summary.one_liner: A Python IDE from JetBrains aimed at data science and AI work, with Jupyter notebook support, SQL support, and built-in AI assistance.
use_cases: Building data models and AI agents in Python
Working with Jupyter notebooks locally or remotely
Writing and exploring SQL against databases
Browsing and using Hugging Face models in notebooks
summary.what_it_does: The page describes PyCharm as a Python IDE for building data models and AI agents. It supports Jupyter notebooks (local and remote), including AI-generated cells, converting notebooks to Python scripts, and a debugger. It offers Python and SQL support, refactoring, real-time error detection, and interactive tables for no-code data exploration. It integrates Hugging Face models and datasets, suggesting relevant pre-trained models and flagging unused ones to free disk space. The page also lists integrations with Git, conda, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Docker and many data libraries.
notable: Hugging Face model suggestions and dataset inspection inside the IDE
Jupyter notebook support with AI cells and notebook-to-script conversion
Choice of AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, or a local model) and bring-your-own AI keys
SOC 2 attestation stated on the page
caveats: Page says 'Free forever, plus one month of Pro included' but does not detail what free tier includes or ongoing Pro pricing
AI features depend on JetBrains AI credits or the user's own AI subscriptions and API keys
